title: Flexible variational approximations for stochastic volatility-managed portfolios
abstract: arXiv:2212.07288v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper investigates volatility-managed portfolios through a variational Bayes approach that smooths stochastic volatility forecasts. Our algorithm exhibits competitive performance relative to established methods both in terms of inferential accuracy and computational efficiency. Analyzing equity factors and characteristic-based portfolios, we show that smoothing reduces excess leverage and turnover, significantly improving risk-adjusted returns after transaction costs. Importantly, our smoothed stochastic volatility method achieves positive net performance while avoiding extreme negative outcomes, a combination no competing approach attains. We demonstrate that superior forecasting accuracy does not guarantee superior portfolio performance, revealing a fundamental trade-off between model precision and economic utility.

translated_title: 随机波动率管理投资组合的灵活变分近似
translated_abstract: 本文通过一种平滑随机波动率预测的变分贝叶斯方法研究波动率管理投资组合。我们的算法在推断精度和计算效率两方面均表现出与现有方法相比具有竞争力的性能。通过分析股票因子和基于特征的投资组合，我们证明平滑处理可以减少过度杠杆和换手率，显著提高扣除交易成本后的风险调整收益。重要的是，我们的平滑随机波动率方法在实现正的净绩效的同时避免了极端负面结果，这种组合是任何竞争方法都无法实现的。我们证明了更优的预测精度并不能保证更优的投资组合表现，揭示了模型精度与经济效用之间的根本权衡。
tldr: 本文提出一种平滑随机波动率预测的变分贝叶斯方法用于波动率管理投资组合，显著降低杠杆和换手率，在扣除交易成本后实现正的净绩效并避免极端负面结果，揭示了模型预测精度与经济效用之间的根本权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a variational Bayes approach with smoothed stochastic volatility forecasts for volatility-managed portfolios, which reduces leverage and turnover, achieves positive net performance after transaction costs while avoiding extreme negative outcomes, and reveals a fundamental trade-off between forecasting precision and economic utility.
